entries.name: Street light
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Kenney City Kit Roads)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Substitutes for the plan row (street light via poly.pizza, which is blocked): Kenney City Kit Roads light-curved (GLB), the classic single cobra-head street lamp; the kit also has light-square (a squared-off arm), which reads less like a street lamp. Same pack, zip pin and colours as the library traffic-light so street furniture reads as one set: grey pole recoloured pale aluminium (indigo line / moon shade), the lamp face under the head practical amber (a warm lit sodium glow). maxColors 48 as for the traffic light keeps the small white lamp face apart from the grey pole. Scaled to 7 m (real ~6-8 m), arm 2 m. The pipeline centres the bbox, not the pole: the pole base (0.52 m square foot) is centred at x = 0, z = -0.9 m, and the arm reaches forward over +Z to the lamp head at z = +1.17 m (yaw 180 so the lamp overhangs the road in front). To stand the pole on a kerb point P, place the model at P + (0, 0, 0.9) in its own frame. Static, no clips.
